evidence_quotes.two_concerns_question: Not asked. Rep proceeded directly to logistics probing without asking about concerns regarding movers arriving on time or damage to items.
evidence_quotes.two_layers_deep: N/A — no concerns were raised by the customer at step 2.

top_strength: Brianne gathered logistics details systematically and thoroughly — addresses, unit numbers, special items, fragile glass coffee table, elevator access — and confirmed the arrival window with the customer.
coaching_note: This call skipped the two core framework steps (two-concerns question and both promises about reliability and damage protection), never asked for the business explicitly, and gave away the pricing framing benefit (only one of three elements: no-notes line was mentioned, but pricing contrast and fee transparency with the 2.5-hour minimum were absent or buried late). Start every call with the two-concerns opener and deliver the promises before probing.
